Company Overview 
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
 
 Department Overview 
Department Description
At Motorola Solutions, safety and security are at the heart of everything we do, helping people be their best in the moments that matter. Through Priority Intelligence™ and our "Solving for safer" mission, we build AI-assisted technologies that empower human capabilities and protect communities worldwide. 
Job Description
 Join our engineering team to build, debug, and deploy high-quality language and document generation systems across the full software development lifecycle. In our people-first culture, you will partner across product, design, and engineering teams to translate complex business goals into reliable AI applications.

 Responsibilities 
 Write and debug efficient code for language and document generation systems
 Manage assigned development tasks across technical design, coding, testing, and deployment
 Collaborate with developers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to deliver successful projects
 Participate in technical design discussions, providing input on feasibility, estimates, and progress
 Identify opportunities to continuously improve engineering workflows and system performance
 
 Specific Knowledge and Skills 
 Bachelor's Degree
 2+ years of experience in software development
 Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.
 Software Development to design, build, and deploy applications utilizing Python, JavaScript/Node.js, HTML5, CSS, and SQL/BigQuery
 AI & LLM Engineering to design and develop machine learning applications and language generation systems
 Cloud & API Architecture to implement complex service-to-service OAuth2 authentication flows and REST APIs across Google Cloud and AWS
 Database Management to design, deploy, maintain, and modify scalable database structures
 Agile & Developer Tooling to collaborate using Agile methodologies, Git workflows, GitHub, and AI coding assistants such as Gemini or Windsurf
 Technical Communication to translate complex business requirements into clear user stories and present solutions across diverse audiences
 Experience with Google Docs automation preferred
 Proficiency with IDEs such as VSCode, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace preferred
 
 Target Base Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 USD

 Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

 #LI-LD
 
Basic Requirements
 Bachelor's Degree
 2+ years of experience in software development
 Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.
 
Travel Requirements
Under 10% 
Relocation Provided
None 
Position Type
Experienced 
Referral Payment Plan
Yes 
 Our U.S. Benefits include: 
 Incentive Bonus Plans

 Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

 401K with Company Match

 10 Paid Holidays

 Generous Paid Time Off Packages

 Employee Stock Purchase Plan

 Paid Parental & Family Leave

 and more!

 
 EEO Statement 
 
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.  
 
 We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team. 
 
 We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this  Reasonable Accommodations Form  so we can assist you.
